title: Alan Watts - On Prickles and Goo
summary: A short animated excerpt of Alan Watts describing 'prickles' (rigorous, scientific types) and 'goo' (soft, spiritual types). He argues the real division is between prickly goo and gooey prickles.
why: HN uses it as shorthand for the divide between systematizing and humanistic outlooks, applied to arguments about science, society and language.

quote.text: I wish we (academia, and society as a whole) would stop treating science and human concerns as prickles and goo[1].
